mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rate above 4.5% over three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes a slowdown in corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.5%), or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales indicates broad-based consumer demand weakness, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When manufacturing activity falls below 100 (INDPRO < 100), indicating a contraction in industrial production, the S&P 500 typically experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate output and inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC for INDPRO < 100 condition is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals an active monetary tightening cycle, which typically causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in housing starts indicates strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings benefit from a robust economy.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST trends upward, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in non-farm payroll employment below 159,000 in a single month signals a weakening labor market, which typically precedes a slowdown in consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (PAYEMS < 159000), or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in industrial production indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic growth, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate profits improve.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO trends upward, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
